constellation.note: Dataset-specific demodulation; no hard decisions or ideal-point snapping. Input symbols are RMS-normalized per carrier/symbol. PA output uses the input for synchronization and the existing smoothed per-subcarrier equalizer. Equalization is fitted on the displayed capture, can remove linear distortion and does not establish a standard EVM or isolate nonlinear distortion from noise.

measurements.label: PAPR
measurements.method: dataset-doctor-v1; output statistics exclude isolated outliers identified by the doctor. Capture amplitude is not calibrated PA output power.
measurements.name: PAPR

measurements.label: RMS amplitude
measurements.method: dataset-doctor-v1; output statistics exclude isolated outliers identified by the doctor. Capture amplitude is not calibrated PA output power.
measurements.name: RMS

measurements.label: Peak amplitude
measurements.method: dataset-doctor-v1; output statistics exclude isolated outliers identified by the doctor. Capture amplitude is not calibrated PA output power.
measurements.name: PEAK

measurements.label: ACPR left (leakage)
measurements.method: general-spectral-v1: 10*log10( P_adjacent_left(y) / P_main(y) ). Leakage convention: adjacent-channel power relative to the main channel of the same signal, negative dBc, lower is better. The positive 'suppression' convention (main / adjacent, higher is better) equals -ACPR_L and is not reported.
measurements.name: ACPR_L

measurements.label: ACPR right (leakage)
measurements.method: general-spectral-v1: 10*log10( P_adjacent_right(y) / P_main(y) ). Leakage convention: adjacent-channel power relative to the main channel of the same signal, negative dBc, lower is better. The positive 'suppression' convention (main / adjacent, higher is better) equals -ACPR_R and is not reported.
measurements.name: ACPR_R

measurements.label: Capture gain (small signal)
measurements.method: dataset-doctor-v1: small-signal complex gain is +10.27 dB at -1.2 degrees. Gain/phase fit uses the lowest 40% of input amplitudes after integer alignment; this includes the capture/attenuator scale, not calibrated PA gain.
measurements.name: GAIN

measurements.label: Capture phase (small signal)
measurements.method: dataset-doctor-v1: small-signal complex gain is +10.27 dB at -1.2 degrees. Gain/phase fit uses the lowest 40% of input amplitudes after integer alignment; this includes the capture/attenuator scale, not calibrated PA gain.
measurements.name: PHASE

measurements.label: BLA residual NMSE
measurements.method: Residual relative to a best linear approximation; includes noise and unmodelled memory. No universal nonlinearity grade is assigned.
measurements.name: BLA_NMSE

output.reason: A reviewed linear-reference profile is required (alignment, fit window, scalar/FIR reference and denominator). Raw input/output NMSE is not PA nonlinearity.

measurements.label: EVM (RMS)
measurements.method: ofdm-lte20-evm-v1: 100 * sqrt( sum|S_eq - S_ref|^2 / sum|S_ref|^2 ) over occupied subcarriers and complete symbols. Not a conformance result.
measurements.name: EVM_RMS

output.reason: Requires a waveform binding and a reviewed EVM receiver profile; a modulation label or quick-look constellation does not define an EVM protocol

measurements.label: ACLR lower adjacent (leakage)
measurements.method: ofdm-lte20-evm-v1: 10 * log10( P[-29, -11 MHz] / P[-9, +9 MHz] ) from the Welch PSD at the capture rate. Not a conformance result.
measurements.name: ACLR_L

output.reason: Requires a waveform binding and a reviewed EVM receiver profile; a modulation label or quick-look constellation does not define an EVM protocol

measurements.label: ACLR upper adjacent (leakage)
measurements.method: ofdm-lte20-evm-v1: 10 * log10( P[+11, +29 MHz] / P[-9, +9 MHz] ) from the Welch PSD at the capture rate. Not a conformance result.
measurements.name: ACLR_R

output.reason: Requires a waveform binding and a reviewed EVM receiver profile; a modulation label or quick-look constellation does not define an EVM protocol
